notes.title: System optimization and bug fixes
notes.notes: Added dynamic city requirements and trade prices. Fixed several bugs.

notes.title: 8.28 Vehicle Update
notes.notes: [p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45324480/da6a6a9490ed8d525e5120275f77d94786b826a4.png"][/img][/p][p]A new, practical vehicle, the Military Jeep, has been added. Its superior off-road performance stands out among all other combat vehicles. It can carry three weapons: a light machine gun, a small cannon, and a special weapon. While it can carry a wide range of weapons, they are all lightweight. Its price from NPCs is 8000C.[/p][p]-The price of the Van has been reduced to 4000C.[/p][p]-New weapons have been added: a 45mm light cannon and a 12.7mm air-cooled lightweight machine gun.[/p][p]-A black powder cannon has been added to the bandit enemy (don't underestimate this antique weapon!).[/p][p]-New Blacksmith town and trading location have been added.[/p]

notes.title: bug fix
notes.notes: Enemies are smarter and stronger, so please be careful

notes.title: Update machinery
notes.notes: [p]Added two new heavy machines and one manual workbench: Lathe and Punch，Bullets can now be produced automatically[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45324480/1722bb638cb1ee0af1b52e882047c7e6832ace4e.png"][/img][/p][p]Added anvil, which can manually produce simple iron products[/p][p]Added manual production: Some specific workbenches require manual production, such as firearms and assembly of simple tools[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45324480/1a7680ae074c418de06ab8e8287d9e2a9fa6fe16.png"][/img][/p][p]Added blacksmith shop: If you want to buy some finished products directly, you can buy them at the blacksmith shop.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45324480/07c1850073ba677a8e09dfa2448d8edf59d0592f.png"][/img][/p]
